title: quant-kernel: improve INT8/FP8 smoothquant + dequant fusion performance
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce inference latency and memory bandwidth for quantized inference by fusing smoothquant scaling + dequantization into a single CUDA kernel and exposing an INT8/FP8 fast path to the serving runtime. This change targets bottlenecks observed in ENG-2912 where per-token dequant + scale copies dominated time for 7B/13B workloads, and ENG-3010 which tracked regression risk during rollout. Summary of changes: 1) New fused kernel (smoothquant_dequant_fuse.cu) that applies channel-wise smoothquant scaling and dequantizes INT8/FP8 tensors directly into the fp32 accumulation buffer, avoiding an intermediate full-precision copy. 2) Introduced kernel selection heuristics in runtime/kernel_selector.cc to prefer the fused path when model metadata indicates per-channel smoothquant scales and sequence lengths <= 512. 3) KV cache alignment and metadata updates to support quantized cache entries (runtime/kv_cache_quantized.*): avoid copy-on-read by storing quantized tensors packed with 32-byte alignment and a small header with scale/zero-point metadata. 4) Continuous batching tweaks: scheduler now tags batches with quantization-compatibility and coalesces requests that can use the same fused kernel to maximize GEMM utilization. 5) Hardware fallback handling: H100 vs A10 tuning knobs (kernel launch config) and safe fallback to existing dequant path when required features are missing. 6) Unit + perf tests and benchmark harness updates (perf-canary integration). Benchmarks: microbenchmarks (perf-canary) show median throughput improvements of ~1.6x on the INT8 path for a GPT-like 7B model (seq=256, bs=8) and ~1.4x on FP8 path; p95 latency improved by ~20-30% for short-seq traffic. Compatibility & correctness: added deterministic numerical checks and reference dequant comparisons in tests/quant_roundtrip_test.py to ensure no quality regressions on representative prompts. Metrics: added counter metrics for kernel selection frequency and quantized cache hit rate (observability/metrics.yaml). Rollout plan: canary rollout on 5% of production traffic with auto-rollback if perf-regression >5% or if quality (token-level logits) deviates beyond configured thresholds. Related linear tickets: ENG-2912, ENG-3010. Notes: this change focuses on fusion and scheduler heuristics only; it does not change model file formats or persistent storage layout beyond adding a small runtime header for cached quantized tensors.

release_notes:
- Added fused smoothquant + dequant kernel (INT8/FP8) reducing memory copies and improving throughput for short-sequence workloads.
- Runtime kernel selection heuristics and continuous-batching coalescing for quantized fast paths.
- KV cache quantized storage header and alignment to avoid copy-on-read.
- New metrics for kernel selection and quantized cache hit rate.
Rollout: staged canary with auto-rollback thresholds; no model format changes.
